title: Plot-Thread Tracker and Loose Ends
dataSources: Campaign sessions (`campaign:session`), NPC ledger (`npc:ledger`), loot drops (`loot:drop`), XP awards (`xp:award`).
app: Tabletop RPG telemetry — virtual-tabletop session logs (Roll20, Foundry VTT), campaign trackers (World Anvil), and XP / loot / NPC ledgers — streamed to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=campaign:session event=plot_thread
| stats latest(status) as status, latest(_time) as updated by thread
| eval stale_days=round((now()-updated)/86400,0)
| where status="open" AND stale_days>60
| sort - stale_days
description: Tracks open story threads and flags the ones the party has not touched in a while, so none is forgotten.
value: Dangling plot threads frustrate players; a loose-ends tracker helps the game master weave them back in.
implementation: Log plot threads into `index=personal`; flag long-dormant open threads.
visualization: Table of open plot threads by days since last touched.
grandmaExplanation: It tracks the open story threads and flags ones the group has forgotten, so the plot stays tight.
